comments.content: Thread-safety: `bubbleShownThisRound` is a plain unsynchronized `var`, but the write path (`onBubbleShown`) and the read-and-reset path (`onReturnToIdle`) run on different threads in the only consumer (VoiceSessionManager): `onBubbleShown()` is invoked from `Dispatchers.IO` pipeline/TTS/error paths (lines 933/1042/1083) and from `playAckThenListen`, while `onReturnToIdle()` runs inside `transition()` on a different execution context. With no happens-before edge (no @Volatile, no lock), a `true` written on an IO thread may be invisible to the IDLE-transition reader, silently dropping the 12s hide and leaving the bubble stuck on screen — exactly the failure mode the critic-S5 ruling aims to prevent. The read-then-clear is also non-atomic, so concurrent IDLE transitions can race on the flag. Since this class advertises "pure JVM logic, zero Android imports", use a JDK-only `java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean`: `getAndSet(false)` provides both cross-thread visibility and an atomic read-and-reset, and lets `onReturnToIdle` become a single-expression function.
comments.thinking:
Confirmed: the manager runs pipeline/TTS work on `Dispatchers.IO`/`Dispatchers.Default`, and the `onBubbleShown` calls at lines 933/1042/1083 sit inside those pipeline/TTS paths (line 933 is inside pipeline error path, 1042/1083 inside TTS consumer/producer paths on Dispatchers.IO). Meanwhile `transition(...)` → `onReturnToIdle()` at 1237 — transitions are triggered from various places; even if transition itself happens on a consistent thread, the flag writes happen on IO dispatcher threads (e.g., error paths inside `Dispatchers.IO` coroutines). Without `@Volatile`/atomics, there is no happens-before edge between the write on an IO thread and the read on whatever thread runs `transition`. This is a genuine JMM visibility hazard: a `true` write from an IO-dispatcher error path may not be visible to the IDLE-transition reader → missed hide → bubble stuck (exactly the outcome the S5 ruling wants to avoid).

Also read-and-reset non-atomicity: two concurrent IDLE transitions could both observe true (benign per design due to STALE tokens), but the more dangerous direction (lost true) is covered by atomicity fix.

So finding 1: thread safety — recommend `AtomicBoolean` (keeps zero-Android-import JVM purity) with `getAndSet(false)`; or at minimum `@Volatile` (but @Volatile alone doesn't make read-and-reset atomic; concurrent IDLE double-fire is benign per design though). AtomicBoolean is the clean fix.

Finding 2 (low, maintainability/documentation): `onReturnToIdle` resets the flag before the caller has actually acted on `true`; if `bubble.hideLater` scheduling fails or the return value is dropped, the pending hide is lost with no retry (until next show/IDLE round). Since the class doc already states service-side STALE tokens make duplicate hide requests harmless, a slightly safer contract is possible — but it's a documented one-shot design decision. I'll add a low-severity maintainability note suggesting documenting that the return value is a one-shot token that must not be dropped (or rename to `consumePendingHide`), anchored on the onReturnToIdle function.

comments.content: WHITESPACE_RUN 的空白集合比保留过滤器窄，与桌面端 sidecar 的 Python isspace() 不再逐字符一致：Character.isWhitespace() 含 U+001C–U+001F（file/group/record/unit separator），但 Java 正则 \s 无 UNICODE_CHARACTER_CLASS 时仅匹配 [ \t\n\x0B\f\r]，且它们是 Cc 类目、\p{Z} 也不含 —— 结果 "a\u001Cb" 不会被压缩成 "a b"，而是带着控制符作为单个 token 送进 TTS；反向地，U+0085(NEL) 在这里被 isWhitespace/isSpaceChar 双双排除而直接剥除（"a\u0085b" → "ab"），而 Python isspace() 会把它当空白切分（→ "a b"），造成单词粘连。两种情况都破坏了类头声明的 parity。建议把正则字符类与过滤谓词同源对齐。

comments.content: filter 按 UTF-16 code unit 逐字符判定：增补平面字母（如 CJK 扩展 B 的 U+20BB7「𠮷」，真实人名/地名用字）会被拆成高低代理对，两个孤立代理都不是 letterOrDigit 而被双双剥除；Python isalnum 按码点判定会保留。后果：混排文本被悄悄削字（"𠮷野家"→"野家"，朗读内容与桌面端不一致）；纯增补平面文本则清洗为空串、整句跳过合成。末尾的 cleaned.any { it.isLetterOrDigit() } 有同样盲区，代理对文本即使过滤侧修好也仍会误判为"无 alnum"。注意：这是独立于 implementation-notes 已留档的 No/Nl(²、½、Ⅳ) 偏差之外、未被追踪的 parity 缺口。建议按码点（代理对配对后用 Character.isLetterOrDigit(Int)）遍历过滤与可读性判定。
"与桌面端 sidecar._TTS_KEEP_PUNCT 逐字符一致"这条硬约束目前只靠注释背书，没有任何机制防止两端漂移；白名单一旦不同步（sidecar HEAD 前进时尤甚），用户听到的朗读内容会静默改变（如剥除 #/@/_ 使 "C#" 读成 "C"）。建议用单测把 sidecar 的确切字面量钉死：逐字符断言其在 sanitize 后原样保留，白名单漂移时 CI 即刻变红。
